headword: {自己中心的|じこちゅうしんてき}

definitions.explanation: Describes a person or behavior focused primarily on one's own interests, needs, or perspective without regard for others.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{自己中心的|じこちゅうしんてき}な{人|ひと}だ。
{自己中心的|じこちゅうしんてき}な{考|かんが}え{方|かた}を{改|あらた}めたほうがいい。
examples.english: You should change your self-centered way of thinking.

examples.japanese: {自己中心的|じこちゅうしんてき}な{行動|こうどう}ばかりしていると、{周|まわ}りの{人|ひと}が{離|はな}れていく。
examples.english: If you keep acting selfishly, people around you will drift away.

notes:
USAGE:
Often abbreviated in casual speech to {自己中|じこちゅう} (or ジコチュー). The abbreviation is common among younger speakers and is slightly more informal and blunt.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自己中心的|じこちゅうしんてき}な{人|ひと} (a self-centered person)
- {自己中心的|じこちゅうしんてき}な{考|かんが}え{方|かた} (a self-centered way of thinking)
- {自己中心的|じこちゅうしんてき}な{行動|こうどう} (selfish behavior)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {利己的|りこてき}: selfish — more formal, emphasizes pursuing personal gain
- {我|わ}がまま: selfish, spoiled — more emotional and everyday
- {自己中|じこちゅう}: abbreviated casual form of this word
